verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a business-filing authority could plausibly document registered agents, authorized filers, or representative access. The pack, however, never describes a sanctioned third-party rail. The only nearby item is a mention of 'Filing Administrator functions' in the Ohio Business Gateway, which does not say whether outside providers can act for a company. The SoS site and the Ohio Business Central portal returned 403 at robots.txt, so no first-party documentation on registered agents or designees could be checked.
